# Skyline Valley map with all the resources for your camp

![Skyline Valley map with all resources for your camp](/uploads/380_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update 03/28/2025] Deposit map updated

With the map expansion to Skyline Valley, there are now numerous new resources in the new area. Many players like to build their camp on copper, aluminum, lead or iron veins in order to collect ores at the same time. Extractors can be set up on the deposits to make it easier for you to access the ores and extract them.

Here you will find a map of the whole of Applachia including Skyline Valley with all available resources:

- Aluminum
- Black titanium
- Coal
- Copper
- Crystal
- Ultracite
- Gold
- Iron
- Lead
- Silver
- Scrap
- phosphate
- Uranium (nuclear material)
- acid
- Crystal
- Oil
- Cement
- Wood

*Click on the map to download full size. If you would like to share the map, it is best to use the link from the article so that the map is not compressed so much when you send it that you can no longer see it.*

![Appalachia including Skyline Valley map with all resources](/uploads/nukaknights-mappalachiamap-skyline-valley-all-resources-1280.jpg) 

## Map only with depots / deposits for your extractors

![Appalachia map including Skyline Valley with all deposits for extractors](/uploads/nukaknights-mappalachiamap-all-deposits-piles-appalachia-sv-1280.jpg) 

The map was created with Mappalachia.
